_comments: AUTO-CALIBRATED profile for source owcs-jksix-qwc (calib-v1). Chip rows located by HSV blob detection +
uniform-pitch fitting over multiple frames; portrait cells
placed next to their ult chips with texture-driven refinement.
Pixel rects are at 1920x1080 native; norm_* are fractions of

_note: REAL crop, not a placeholder. The persistent broadcast chyron
'OWCS 2026 | STAGE 2 | PLAYOFFS' at the top-left of this production's
overlay. Cut by pipeline/build_anchor_template.py from
reports/ingest/qad-twis-nepal/frames/frame_2175.jpg (a REAL 1280x720
broadcast frame of the verified Nepal map, classified 'gameplay' in
reports/ingest/qad-twis-nepal/observations.jsonl) and stored upscaled to
the rect's 1920-native size so capture.region_score's resize keeps
template and crop aligned at every capture resolution.
WHY THIS REGION. It carries no match state. The bracket label
('LOWER SEMIFINAL', x>=280 at 720p), the team nameplates, the map
number and the round-state row all change within a single VOD, and
owcs_nd5lllwdky0.json records what that costs: an anchor cut from the
round-state row scored -0.15 on genuine gameplay and the filter threw
the frames away. Measured on the same 11 real frames, widening the rect
to [45,9,528,36] so it swallows the bracket label drops the best
achievable worst-case score from 0.981 to 0.822; this rect holds 0.97+.
MEASURED (pipeline/test_gameplay_anchor.py re-measures all of it):
7 committed real gameplay frames ......... 0.981 - 0.996
4 real gameplay tiles, calibration sheet .. 0.987 - 0.992
same positives resampled to 1920/1280/640 . >= 0.974
same positives resampled to 854x480 ....... >= 0.851 (worst case)
best match ELSEWHERE in the same frames ... <= 0.593
frames with a different/no HUD ............ <= 0.000
min_score 0.60 sits above every negative AND above the worst
same-frame decoy, with 0.25 of headroom under the worst positive.
SCOPE, HONESTLY: this proves 'this broadcast's HUD is on screen', which
is what the gameplay filter needs from an anchor. It is NOT a replay
discriminator for this source — a replay here renders a full HUD, and
no replay/scoreboard FRAME of this VOD is committed, so that claim
could not be measured. Replays keep being caught by the three real
reject markers below, which gameplay_state checks BEFORE the anchor.
